model: monthly anchor (2-season avg, Easter-corrected, TVB level) x daily shape (mean of holiday-aligned previous year and LightGBM)
interval: split-conformal 80 % (calibrated on real winter 24/25, coverage 0.77 on 25/26)
capacity: stays + free beds on the same weekday last year (TVB free beds end 7 Nov 2026)
sources: TVB Paznaun-Ischgl with feratel (TTF 2026 data licence)
